entries.name: Anchor bolt group
entries.description: Draws a grid of anchor bolts (circle with cross) centered on a point.

entries.name: Axis
entries.description: Draws a single grid axis between two picked points: a center-line with a labeled bubble at the start, the end, or both.

entries.name: Bolt
entries.description: Draws a schematic side view of a bolt between two picked points — hex head, shank and threaded end. The pick distance sets the length, the pick order the direction.

entries.name: Borehole
entries.description: Draws a borehole symbol (half-filled circle) with its id.

entries.name: Break line
entries.description: Draws a break/interruption line: zigzag jog or S-curve at the middle.

entries.name: Cloud
entries.description: Draws a cloud shape to represent a structure on hold.

entries.name: Detail mark
entries.description: Draws a section mark with a label

entries.name: Drawing frame
entries.description: Draws a drawing frame.

entries.name: Grid
entries.description: Draws a rectangular grid of axes from Tekla-style spacing strings "0 2*7200" with auto-incrementing labels. Requires the @lineadraw/axis block.

entries.name: Insulation
entries.description: Draws the standard insulation symbol of the given width along a picked line: a triangle zigzag for hard (rigid) insulation, a rounded square wave for soft (batt) insulation.

entries.name: Parma Hollow Core Profile
entries.description: Draws the cross-section of a Parma precast hollow-core slab: catalog outline with grout keys and the void pattern, centered on the pick.

entries.name: Rebar Section
entries.description: Draws a row of rebars in section view (filled dots) between two picked points, distributed by count or by spacing.

entries.name: Rebar
entries.description: Draws a bent rebar through picked points: the centerline with bending-radius fillets and end ticks, or the true-thickness outline for the selected bar size.

entries.name: Section line
entries.description: Draws a section line with a label

entries.name: Section mark
entries.description: Draws a section mark with a label

entries.name: Steel Beam
entries.description: Draws a steel beam in elevation between two picked points, from the European catalogs (IPE, HEA/HEB, UPE/UPN, L…): solid outer edges, dashed hidden edges.

entries.name: Steel Profile
entries.description: Draws the cross-section of a European steel catalog profile (IPE, HEA/HEB, UPE/UPN, L…) with root fillets, centered on the pick.

entries.name: Surface
entries.description: Draws a ground-surface symbol along the line between two picked points, with rock, earth, excavated-rock and removed-earth variants.

entries.name: Title
entries.description: Draws a sheet title block filled from text-field parameters: project, site, designer and drawing information.

entries.name: Waterproofing
entries.description: Draws a waterproofing membrane band along picked points: a closed outline of the given width with a dashed centerline.

entries.name: Narrow Selection
entries.description: Keeps only objects of one type (or block definition) in the current selection.
